parts.t: Big Bad Brain Wrestling: the physics of fake pain and the economy of real ego.
Toy box, cardboard ring. Me: commando, the only real gun in here. Everybody else just wrestles.
The No-Sell Monster ignores damage, sits right back up: remove all tension for ego.
The Shooter forces opponent to sell; if they refuse, real damage. Stiff the no-seller.
The Real Injury, unplanned: Goldberg's shoulder, ring-post. Crowd goes nuts because it's real.
The Kayfabe Police enforce the lie: arrest anyone breaking character. Keep secrets secret.
The Kayfabe Police never came for me. I call it fake all day. My gun is plastic. Still real to me, dammit.
